comments:
3af2a9ac:  ;This routine is used for editing/entering IRT records.
 ;It allows users to select a patient record and update its status.
abacbd8a: ;Initialize flags and set DGJTECOM to indicate entry into the COMPLETED IRT option.
bf0924b9: ;Check for the division setup in the MAS system parameter file and prompt for division if multiple are present.
92071fe1: ;Default to the first division in the MEDICAL CENTER DIVISION file if no division has been selected.
1a26eaa8: ;Warn the user that division parameters for delinquency tracking need to be configured if they're not found.
441f5d6c: ;Set DGJTCOM to the appropriate status code based on whether the site uses 'REVIEWED' or 'SIGNED NO REVIEW' as the completion status.
83b4cd90: ;Prompt the user to select a patient record that matches the division and completion status criteria.
e3ff909c: ;Call the viewer to display the selected IRT record.
ab81369c: ;Check for timeout, user exit, or abnormal termination conditions and return to the main option if detected.
c03eb186: ;Loop back to allow selection of another patient record.
bd14316a: ;Clean up variables used in this routine before quitting.
0b0bc50c: ;Further clean up of additional variables and temporary globals.
